domain: Pseudospectral T^3, N=16, IC |k|_inf<=4, E=0.5, full dealias. NOT continuum.
statement: For all divergence-free Fourier ICs on N=16 with |k|_∞≤4 and energy 0.5, evolved with dealiased Galerkin NS (ν=0.1), one has Ω(t) ≤ 48.15928260103266 for all t ∈ [0, 0.01605791], via radial Young bounds on L×L and H×L (ρ_★=1392, γ_cross=37.31) plus NS cancellation ODE. Does NOT claim T=0.02.
